text:
Type: striped flatwoven area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area or bed; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: handwoven-look flat weave, textured melange yarn, short fringed ends
Colors: light grey melange, black stripes, white flecks
Shape: rectangle with even thin black horizontal stripes, flat profile, subtly textured surface, medium-large, light visual weight
Feel: calm, crisp, natural
Goes with: light wood, white or grey walls, black metal accents, linen textiles; Scandinavian, Japandi or modern living rooms

product.name: RASKMLLE
product.description: Handwoven by skilled craftspeople, each one is unique. Made in India in organised weaving centres with good working conditions and fair wages.
